# Notes:
# - ffmpeg and ffprobe are required as system binaries (not Python packages).
# - Some packages (pydantic, starlette) are pulled in by fastapi.
# - If additional features are needed (e.g., audio separation, movie editing), add packages like "audio-separator" or "moviepy" as required.
#
# --- Installing torch (CPU vs GPU) ---
# This project runs on CPU by default (DEVICE=cpu in .env) and does NOT require a GPU.
# torch is left unpinned above because the correct build depends on your hardware:
#
#   CPU only (default, works everywhere):
#     pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
#
#   NVIDIA GPU (CUDA 12.1 example — check https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/
#   for the CUDA version matching your installed NVIDIA driver):
#     pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
#
# Install torch FIRST using one of the commands above, then run:
#     pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# `audio-separator` also auto-installs `onnxruntime` (CPU) by default; for GPU-accelerated
# audio separation, install `onnxruntime-gpu` instead (see audio-separator's own docs).
